api_console.title: API Console
api_console.lab_pointer_hint: Editor's working version. Activate to publish.
api_console.diff_breaking_warning: Activating this version will break existing integrators. Coordinate before publishing.
api_console.diff_empty: No schema differences between Production and Lab.
api_console.activate_hint_locked: Lab version is locked and ready. Activating overwrites Production.
api_console.activate_hint_unlocked: Lock the Lab schema first before activating.
api_console.rename_hint: Renaming changes the public /extract/{api_code} path. Production version stays exactly as it is — no Lab promotion.
api_console.rollback_section: Rollback to a previous locked version
api_console.unpublish_hint: Unpublishing pauses /extract/{api_code} (returns 403). The api_code stays bound and can be re-published.
api_console.keys_empty: No keys yet. Create one to call /extract.
api_console.snippets_hint: Replace EMERGE_API_KEY with your secrets-manager value. The API key is shown once on creation.
api_console.feedback_example_hint: Production callers POST corrections to /extract/{api_code}/feedback. Use the form below to send a real test correction.

feedback.section_hint: Paste an API key (revealed once on creation) and a recent prediction id from /extract. Lab corrections via Studio do not need this — they post as Annotations.
feedback.key_required: Create an API key above before sending test feedback.
feedback.key_helper: Pasted key is not saved by the UI — it lives in component state only and is cleared on submit.
feedback.correct_value_helper: Parsed as JSON when valid (numbers, true/false, null, arrays, objects); otherwise treated as a plain string.

errors.request_id_must_be_positive: Request id must be a positive integer.
errors.entity_index_must_be_non_negative: Entity index must be a non-negative integer.

projects.title: Your projects

projects.create_dialog_hint: Describe it in your own words…
projects.list_empty: No projects yet. Create your first project to get started.
projects.nl_placeholder_hint: Natural-language onboarding lands in v1.1. For now, name your project and pick a template or start empty.
projects.empty_project_hint: Start with a blank schema and add fields yourself.

studio.preview_placeholder_hint: Real PDF preview lands in v1.1; for now use the entity editor on the right.

report_wrong.dialog_hint: This saves a Lab correction (Annotation). Production integrators send the same JSON shape via /extract/{api_code}/feedback.

errors.no_prediction: Cannot report — this document has no prediction yet.

schema.empty: No active version found for this project.
schema.no_fields: No fields defined yet. Add fields to start extracting.

publish.key_modal_title: API key — copy now (shown only once)

publish.key_modal_ack_label: I have copied this key to a safe place.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the form and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: You're moving too fast — try again in a moment.

readiness.no_active_version: No active Lab version yet. Create or open the schema editor.
readiness.active_version_unlocked: Lab version is not locked. Lock the schema before publishing.
readiness.empty_schema: Schema is empty. Add at least one field before publishing.
readiness.schema_not_lock_candidate: Schema is not yet a lock candidate. Keep reviewing documents.
readiness.schema_still_stabilizing: Schema is still stabilizing — review more documents before locking.
readiness.risky_fields_present: Some fields show low confidence on vibe-check documents.
readiness.no_production_feedback: No production feedback yet — the first integrator call will populate regression data.
readiness.low_evidence: Evidence is thin: review more documents or expand the vibe-check set.
readiness.low_field_evidence: Few fields have quote-level evidence. Saving corrections produces evidence.

readiness.risky_no_signal: No verdicts yet — risky fields appear after the judge runs.

maturity.stabilizing: Stabilizing — review risky fields before locking
maturity.lock_candidate: Lock candidate — ready to lock once evidence is in

readiness.no_feedback_callout: No production feedback yet — readiness reflects Lab evidence only. The first integrator call will populate regression data.

review.title: Review Inbox
review.all_caught_up: All caught up — nothing in the review queue right now.
review.needs_judge: Waiting on the judge — no verdicts yet for the {{count}} document(s) in the vibe-check pool.
review.empty_pool: No documents in the vibe-check pool yet — extract a few to start reviewing.
review.section_required_hint: Documents where the judge flagged at least one field.
review.section_spot_check_hint: Random sample from the vibe-check set with no flagged fields.
review.section_all_hint: Every document in the current vibe-check set.
review.section_required_empty: All caught up — no flagged documents.
review.section_spot_check_empty: No spot-check picks for this project yet.
review.section_all_empty: No documents in the vibe-check set yet.
